title: Chapter 674
text:
"Huff … Huff …"
Sylvia was wearing a lightweight mechanical battle suit, and her shield was constantly activated. The head protection equipment of the battle suit was a half-circle of metal mechanical rings around the back of her head and fixed to her ears. Her face was protected by a translucent arc-shaped shield, and she held a silver alloy sword in her hand.
At this moment, she was panting heavily like a bellows. She felt as if her lungs were about to burn, and the wet sweat stuck to the battle suit, making it slippery and sticky.
Roar!
A Thousand Beast Soldier suddenly charged out from the side, and its huge metal mechanical claws attacked. The claws vibrated at a high frequency, appearing blurry.
Sylvia forced herself to focus, gritted her teeth, and raised her sore arm. The slender and tough silver alloy sword in her hand slashed horizontally. The claw and sword collided, creating intense sparks.
Clang!
The light but tough mechanical battle suit increased its output, and Sylvia's speed suddenly increased. She quickly changed her moves, spinning her sword and stabbing at the Thousand Beast Soldier from a strange angle. Mechanical Force lightning flashed on the alloy sword, and a yellow light flowed on the blade, instantly stabbing into the body of this Thousand Beast Soldier.
Bang!
A thick yellow beam of light pierced through the body of the Thousand Beast Soldier and shot out from its back, leaving a bloody hole. This Thousand Beast Soldier was sent flying and fell on the metal floor, dead. Around him were countless corpses of Thousand Beast Soldiers, as well as broken cannons.
This was the surface battlefield of one of the satellite fortresses in the Bloodshed Land's logistics transit station. A landing force was advancing with difficulty toward the core energy furnace of the satellite fortress. Thousand Beast Soldiers swarmed in from all directions, and the two sides fought fiercely. Everywhere they passed, corpses were left behind.
Sylvia had countless comrades around her, either firing with heavy cannons or blocking with electromagnetic shields. She was also a member of the landing force, maintaining the safety of the flanks.
She had been fighting for a long time with her sword, but she could not remember if she had killed a hundred or two hundred Thousand Beast Soldiers. Her battle suit was damaged, and she had suffered minor injuries. She was sweating profusely and exhausted.
In the middle of the battlefield, the explosions and roars were deafening. Sylvia could not hear anything else, only knowing that she kept moving forward, forward, and forward with the main force.
He raised his head and looked at the sky. Outside the armed satellite fortress, there was a spectacular picture of interstellar war. Countless brilliant 'shooting stars' flew across the dark sky and weaved into a net of light. It was the brilliance of countless ion cannons, which illuminated the eternal darkness and burned in the silence.
Sylvia's vision was suddenly shrouded by a strong light. An ion cannon landed on the ground not far away, hitting the black mass of Thousand Beast Soldiers and blasting a large number of them away.
Boom!
The fleet could occasionally break the satellite's shield for a short period of time, providing support and clearing the obstacles for the landing force to reach the energy furnace.
"It almost hit us." Sylvia was still in shock. Before she could catch her breath, a few more light cannons shot over. She had no choice but to immediately enlarge the shield on her arm to block them.
Bang bang bang!
Balls of light exploded on the shield, and her arm suffered from the recoil. She felt a sharp pain in her arm and shoulder bones, and she could barely lift them up. Sylvia gritted her teeth and endured the pain. She wanted to cry, but no tears came out. There was only one thought in her mind.
I really want to go back to school!
At least my life is not in danger!
Three years ago, Sylvia had reached Grade B and excitedly reported the good news to Han Xiao. Han Xiao was very pleased and threw her into the advance team to undergo combat training.
At first, Sylvia was quite happy, but now, she was filled with regret.
Furthermore, the direct superior of this team was Lagi. Before every battle, Lagi would follow the procedures in the work manual and boost the morale of his subordinates. Every time, she felt that she would definitely die.
At this time, a black figure suddenly flew over from the sky and landed heavily on the ground not far away. Under the impact of the huge force, the metal ground seemed to have turned into paper. It was twisted and wrinkled, and a crater was formed.
This figure seemed to have fallen quite heavily, and he only got up after a long time. He flew into the air and looked at the landing team that Sylvia was in.
Upon seeing the appearance of this person, Sylvia's heart sank. This person was an enemy Calamity Grade Super who was guarding the logistics transit station. He was supposed to be fighting in outer space, but he had actually landed on the surface of the satellite. It seemed like he had been shot down by someone.
The battlefield was changing rapidly, and the expressions of the people in the landing team changed. They all turned toward this Calamity Grade opponent and prepared to deal with the attack. There was no Calamity Grade leader among them.
Just when everyone was extremely nervous, another meteor fell from the sky and landed heavily on this Calamity Grade Super, sending him flying dozens of kilometers away. A sonic boom was created and the surrounding Thousand Beast Soldiers were blown away. Sylvia and the others were also blown away by the strong wind.
"It's Your Excellency Marian!"
"Too timely. I almost thought I was going to die."
Sylvia heard the exclamations behind her. She steadied her sword and looked over. The 'meteor' that had sent the Calamity Grade Super flying was floating in the air. It was the Grade A Mechanical Pugilist who had joined the Black Star Army three years ago, Marian.
Marian's entire body was wrapped in a pitch-black, super-heavy mecha. He looked like a heavily-armored knight. He turned his head to look at the disembarking troops and nodded his head, indicating that the disembarking troops should continue moving forward and that they didn't need to worry about anything else.
He then accelerated and disappeared from the spot, chasing after the enemy Calamity Grade and focusing on his own opponent.
"I wonder how the battle up there is going …"
Sylvia retracted her gaze and looked up at the sky once more. Her gaze seemed to be able to pierce through the darkness. She knew that her teacher was currently overseeing the fleet and controlling the entire situation.
At the same time, the Section Zero fleet was crazily attacking the logistics transit station, destroying the enemy battleships one after another.
Han Xiao was in the command room of the flagship, observing the real-time battlefield projection, mobilizing the troops, and conducting the overall situation. Around him stood a circle of staff officers.
Compared to three years ago, Han Xiao's aura was much steadier. He had a simple, short haircut, and his facial features were chiseled. There was a green stubble on his chin, and a compressed orb necklace hung around his neck. He was wearing a large black cloak, but it could not hide his muscular body. From head to toe, he exuded the sexiness of a mature man.
His current identity was the number one commander of this fleet.
This was a standard mixed fleet, with forty-five percent of the fleet belonging to Han Xiao's direct subordinates. The rest were the fleets of a few Section Zero members, and they all listened to Han Xiao's commands.
After three years of development, the Black Star Army had already become one of the top members of Section Zero. One year ago, Purple Crystal had finally come to an agreement with Han Xiao. The Black Star Army had become a long-term cooperative organization, and Han Xiao had become the publicly recognized leader of Section Zero. Thus, Han Xiao himself had the qualifications to be the commander.
Under Purple Crystal's arrangements, Han Xiao was able to lead this fleet, and he was responsible for the logistics of the Bloodshed Land expedition. He had already been fighting outside for half a year.
Being the commander meant that he could not easily take action. Han Xiao no longer took the lead and left everything to his subordinates. Coincidentally, the army had recruited a few new Grade A Supers three years ago, and they were all very useful. They were all reliable talents, and Han Xiao no longer lacked high-level combatants.
As long as he did not meet an expert that he could not deal with, he usually did not have to take action.
He had to train the officers and give them a chance to earn merits. After all, if he took action, his subordinates would not be able to play anymore.
At this time, a few of the staff officers were observing the battlefield projection and discussing loudly.
"The enemy is still resisting. They're covering the logistics team and transporting the resources of the transit station through the stargate. They want to reduce their losses. If we don't stop them, the enemy will be able to recover most of their resources in twenty-seven minutes and retreat through the stargate."
"Not to mention twenty-seven minutes, they won't even be able to last ten minutes. The enemy's defense line has completely collapsed."
"Next, as long as we blow up the stargate, the enemies who have not retreated in time are dead."
Listening to the discussion, Han Xiao stroked his stubble and did not speak.
The core facility of the logistics transit station was the teleportation stargate built by a Star Cluster civilization. The other end was connected to the Seoul Star Cluster. The enemy had set up a satellite fortress shield and fleet to protect the teleportation stargate. After being attacked, they would retreat through the stargate while defending.
Once the enemy retreated, Han Xiao would not be able to chase after them. The other side of the stargate was the enemy's territory. If the stargate was closed, they would be surrounded. Therefore, the condition for winning the battle was to destroy the teleportation stargate before the enemy completely retreated.
The teleportation stargate was a two-way channel. The enemy's reinforcements could come through the stargate, and the enemy needed time to gather reinforcements. The attacking side had the upper hand, so as long as they destroyed the stargate first, this battle would be over.
The Black Star Army had obtained a large amount of resources in the past few years, so Han Xiao was willing to spend a lot of money to expand his fleet. Therefore, the size of this expeditionary fleet was extremely large, and its strength crushed the guards of the transit station. The battlefield projection showed that the enemy's line of defense had collapsed, and the teleportation stargate was exposed.
Seeing this, an aide laughed and said, "The enemy has no chance. We've won."
As soon as he said that, the blue vortex in the center of the stargate fluctuated and spat out battleships one after another. The reinforcements of the Bloodshed Land had arrived and joined the battle immediately, blocking the attack of the fleet.
Han Xiao glanced at the aide speechlessly. This person had an awkward expression, coughed, and avoided Han Xiao's gaze. He pretended to stare at the battlefield projection with a focused expression that said, 'I'm analyzing the battle, don't disturb me'.
"This is the reason why I don't want to talk when the wind is favorable."
Han Xiao sighed.
The appearance of the enemy reinforcements triggered a chain reaction. On the other side, streams of light flew over from the desolate universe belt. A huge fleet stopped at the edge of the battlefield, pincer attacking Han Xiao's fleet with the reinforcements of the Bloodshed Land.
"Ambush?" Everyone's expression changed.
"Yo, looks like this logistics transit station is a trap." Han Xiao raised his brows with a calm expression. He was not surprised at all.
With the battle going so smoothly, he had noticed the problem long ago. With so many logistics transit stations destroyed by him, how could the Bloodshed Land not do anything?
The battleship model of this ambush fleet was completely different from the Bloodshed Land's. This was a fleet belonging to another organization. In the past three years, organizations that wanted to strangle him in the cradle had secretly allied with the Bloodshed Land and participated in the secret war. Han Xiao had already encountered more than ten ambushes and traps aimed at him, so he was already used to it. He felt like something was missing every day he was not assassinated.
Beep beep!
This time, the flagship received a video message from the ambush fleet. A man with metallic skin appeared on the screen. His entire body seemed to be made of metal, and his expression was murderous.
"Black Star, come out and fight!"
"Tsk, this guy is here again."
Han Xiao sighed. This person was also a Beyond Grade A seed. His name was Hadavy, and he was a battle maniac. A year ago, he had entered a battle and specifically looked for Han Xiao to spar with. After being defeated, he escaped.
However, Hadavy did not give up on the challenge. After escaping, he took the initiative to ally with the Bloodshed Land and used the opportunity of the war to enter again and again, treating Han Xiao as a target to train himself. He fought again and again, and when he saw that the situation was not good, he ran very quickly. In Han Xiao's eyes, he was just a sh * t stirrer.
In the past three years, Han Xiao's list of contacts had grown even longer, and correspondingly, he had more enemies.
"You guys take command. I have work to do."
Han Xiao's expression was calm. He casually twisted his neck and walked toward the hatch, leaving the people in the command room with a back as steady as a dog.
